page.content:
Discussion namespace attached to every article and user.

How Talk page connects

  • Topic: Wikipedian — Wikipedians negotiate article text on talk pages.
  • Topic: Neutral point of view — NPOV disputes are argued on talk pages before they reach administrators.

What is Talk page?

Talk pages are where Wikipedians negotiate wording, sources, and disputes beside the article, the backstage of NPOV.

Key threads lead to Wikipedian and Neutral point of view.
